title: QuenFix (Witcher)
description: QuenFix is a utility data pack designed to improve game stability when playing with heavy modpacks.
body:
## Overview

QuenFix (Witcher) is a lightweight compatibility data pack designed specifically for the Witcher (More RPG Series) mod.

Sometimes, the Quen sign or spell from the original mod causes technical conflicts and heavy crashes when used alongside certain other modifications. This data pack solves that problem by completely removing the Quen spell from the game, ensuring a stable and crash-free gameplay experience.

---

## Key Features

- Crash Prevention: Completely removes the Quen spell to protect your modpack from critical errors and crashes.
- Automatic Achievement Adaptation: In-game advancements and achievements automatically adjust to the changes. Since the spell is no longer in the game, achievements (like collecting all spells in the spellbook) automatically stop looking for Quen, allowing them to be completed normally.
- Content Safe: Keeps all other original Witcher mod content, mechanics, and features completely intact without changing anything else.

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft: Java Edition (1.20 - 1.20.1)
- Required Mod: [Witcher More RPG Classes](https://modrinth.com/mod/witcher-rpg-class)
---

## Installation

1. Download the data pack zip file.
2. Place the file inside the datapacks folder of your Minecraft world save.
3. Use the /reload command in-game or restart your world.
